rv.q: It is certainly funny, and with a subject like this it could hardly fail to be, but it still falls short of becoming something more exciting.

In truth, I didn't find a great deal of it especially amusing, (perhaps the detail is still too raw?) but the light groaning and nods of recognition from the largely middle-aged white males ranged about the audience, was encouraging.
What is not assured is the purpose behind this production.
Unfortunately, even with such a strong, capable lead actor, there was nothing to be done to salvage this show.
